name: Bäckerei Habicher - Filiale Postplatz
kurzbeschreibung:
**Bäckerei Habicher – Branch at Postplatz in Nauders**

Welcome to **Bäckerei Habicher**, your trusted bakery in the heart of **Nauders**. Here, we craft fresh bread, delicious pastries, and traditional Tyrolean specialties every day. Start your morning with our buttery **Tiroler Bergkäse** croissants or enjoy a hearty **Kaiserschmarrn** for breakfast. Our selection of **Apfelstrudel** and **Topfenstrudel** is perfect for a sweet treat, while our freshly baked **Vinschgerl** (Tyrolean rye bread) pairs wonderfully with local **Käse** and **Speck**.

Just a short walk from the **Reschenpass**, our bakery is the ideal stop for travelers and locals alike. Whether you're exploring the stunning **Ötztal Alps** or taking a break in **Innsbruck**, our warm, inviting atmosphere and homemade goods make every visit special.

Discover the authentic flavors of **Tirol**—one bite at a time.
